thesis: The episode introduces Wayne Wicker, a senior vice president and chief investment officer at ICMA Retirement Corporation who oversees $50 billion across more than a million retirement accounts for public sector employees. The discussion covers his career path starting with his first 100 shares of Boeing in seventh grade, his education in marketing, finance, and journalism, and his subsequent roles at Boeing, American Express, IDS Financial Services, and Dayton Hudson Corporation.
